'''''Comlink Painting''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] made sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It depicted [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]]-printed blueprints of a [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]] system.
